description: One passage in a doctrine's biblical inventory. Evidence classification, relationship to the doctrine, and research status. See RESEARCH-STANDARDS.md sections 1, 2, 5 and 9. A not-started record has evidenceClassification, relationshipToDoctrine and all research fields null or empty.

book.description: Canonical book name, e.g. Genesis, John, Matthew, 2 Corinthians.

canonicalOrder.description: Position of the book in the Protestant canonical order (Genesis 1 … Revelation 66).

crossReferences.description: Cross-references to other passages. Empty until researched.

note.description: Why the two passages are related.

passageId.description: Id of another passage in the same doctrine inventory.

doctrine.description: The doctrine this inventory entry belongs to.

evidenceClassification.description: See RESEARCH-STANDARDS.md section 1. Null until the classification is researched and justified.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. gen-1-26. Must match the frontend passage id where one already exists.

interpretiveQuestions.description: Open interpretive questions the research must answer. Empty until researched.

notes.description: Researcher notes. Never a substitute for a verified field.

relationshipToDoctrine.description: How this passage relates to the doctrine. Null until researched. Must distinguish what the text states / what may be inferred / how historical writers read it / how doctrine was later formulated (standards section 2).

text.description: Explanation of the relationship. Null until researched.

verificationRecordIds.description: Ids of verification records covering claims in this passage record.

title: Trace the Doctrine — Biblical Passage (per doctrine)
